summary: Vir Biotechnology filed an 8-K disclosing a Collaboration and License Agreement with Gilead Sciences dated October 9, 2026, covering discovery and engineering of three novel PRO-XTEN dual-masked T-cell engager candidates against solid tumor antigens. Concurrently, a Stock Purchase Agreement provides for Gilead to buy 1,765,486 Vir shares at $14.16 per share, roughly $25 million, subject to customary closing conditions, with standstill, voting and lockup provisions expiring one year after expected closing plus a one-year-later resale registration right. This is a strategic collaboration and private placement, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor named.
